text:
maria: quick idea — instead of straight 1:1 conversion, propose a "conversion ladder" that unlocks extra reserved credit on renewal/commit. open to feedback.
suresh: ladder makes sense. e.g., 80% upfront, +10% on renewal within 180d, +10% if they sign 12mo reserved. need SKU mapping from marketplace SKUs to Redwood reserved SKUs.
ana: ana (finance): ladder affects rev-rec and creates clawback risk. i'll model churn buckets and amortization; we need triggers for recognition and a clawback policy.
ben: legal: will check AWS/Azure private-offer terms for converting vendor credits. no double-dip, expiry window, and clawback language needed. i'll draft redline.
jess: SE: field likes ladder; suggests SI onboarding voucher for co-sell deals and a clear eligibility table. Console UX should show pending/unlocked amounts.
samir: ops: flow = verify marketplace token -> create reservation voucher with unlock flags -> emit events + webhook to partner. ensure idempotency and rate-limit handling.
billing-bot: billing-bot: created tracking stub BRG-9012 for ladder pilot ✅
ana: example: marketplace $12k -> upfront convert 80% ($9.6k) applied; $1.2k unlocked on renewal; $1.2k bonus on 12mo commit.
jess: product: show checkbox in Console during private-offer acceptance: "Convert marketplace credits into Redwood Dedicated reservation credits (enroll in ladder)" with tooltip and unlock dates.
suresh: ops action: create INF-4720 for SKU mapping & verification workflow; attach sample CSV.
ben: legal will circulate redline by Wed.
ana: finance will book 30m with accounting to align on rev-rec and clawbacks.
maria: GTM: i'll draft seller/partner messaging (why ladder vs straight convert). target 6-week pilot with two SI partners. deliverables this week: legal redline, billing prototype, Console mock, SE partner list. objections?
jess: no objections — SE to start partner outreach.
samir: will scope API surfaces for partners to query voucher status.
maria: thanks all — unless objections i'll brief execs Tue with pilot plan.
note: Slack thread-style coordination about a marketplace pricing/offer strategy pilot (conversion ladder) for private offers -> reserved credits. Messages are short and ordered, prefixed by sender names as required.
